abstract.para: Use this procedure to change the configuration of &qdevice; or &qnet; (for example, to change the tie-breaker method from lowest to highest).

important.title: Cluster restart required
important.para: In this procedure, you must stop the cluster services. If any non-fence resources are running, put the cluster into maintenance mode first. This allows the services managed by the resources to keep running even when you stop the cluster services. However, the resources won't be highly available while the cluster is in maintenance mode.

topic.para: Perform this procedure on only one cluster node:

step.para: Log in either as the &rootuser; user or as a user with sudo privileges.
Check whether any resources are running:
If any non-fence resources are running, put the cluster into maintenance mode:

In this state, the cluster stops monitoring all resources. This allows the services managed by the resources to keep running even when you stop the cluster services. However, the resources won't be highly available while the cluster is in maintenance mode.
Stop the cluster services on all nodes:
